blocks.text: Preserved Apple note state

The first retained raw Apple DocC state after macOS Sequoia 15 Beta 1 and before Beta 2 identifies itself as macOS Sequoia 15 Beta Release Notes. It contains 144 normalized list records, 142 of them carrying a retained issue identifier.

citations.locator: Human capture 20240610230634; exact raw payload 20240619212721; macOS Sequoia 15 Beta Release Notes

blocks.text: Representative Beta 1 inventory

This page structures 12 high-signal entries across user-facing behavior, compatibility, privacy, and developer APIs. It is a selective index of the preserved state, not a reproduction of Apple's complete list.

citations.locator: Human capture 20240610230634; exact raw payload 20240619212721; macOS Sequoia 15 Beta Release Notes

blocks.text: Attribution boundary

The archive establishes that these entries were present during the Beta 1 interval. It does not establish their exact publication hour, and nothing from a later cumulative state is projected backward.

System Integrity Protection — New Features; issue 114586798

changes.title: AppKit window-sharing requests
changes.canonicalSummary: AppKit added an API for applications to request sharing of a specific existing or newly supplied window.
changes.summary: Presentation and conferencing workflows can offer focused sharing without requiring every application window to be exposed.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under AppKit — New Features with 115318870 in the first retained 144-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: DirectoryService plug-in removal
changes.canonicalSummary: macOS removed DirectoryService plug-in support and directed identity integrations toward Platform SSO.
changes.summary: Legacy directory plug-ins no longer remain a supported extension path in the first Sequoia beta state.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under DirectoryService — Deprecations with 119515880 in the first retained 144-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: Maps place identity and place cards
changes.canonicalSummary: MapKit added persistent Place IDs, broader local-search result categories, and an API for presenting place-card interfaces.
changes.summary: The initial notes group three MapKit additions for identifying, finding, and presenting places.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under Maps — New Features with 129071038, 129073725, 129073922 in the first retained 144-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: Legacy Quick Look generator removal
changes.canonicalSummary: macOS ended the legacy Quick Look Generator plug-in path and directed developers to preview and thumbnail extensions.
changes.summary: Custom file-preview providers need the supported extension APIs instead of the older generator plug-in model.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under Quick Look — Deprecations with 116791365 in the first retained 144-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: RealityKit subdivision and Display P3 rendering
changes.canonicalSummary: RealityKit added Catmull-Clark subdivision for qualifying USD meshes and Display P3 rendering for virtual objects.
changes.summary: The rendering changes expand mesh smoothing and wide-color output while documenting the resource cost of subdivision.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under RealityKit — New Features with 129016034, 129017592 in the first retained 144-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: Privacy alerts for legacy screen-capture APIs
changes.canonicalSummary: Applications using deprecated display-capture APIs can trigger system privacy alerts and should migrate to ScreenCaptureKit.
changes.summary: The first beta documents a more visible privacy consequence for continuing to use legacy capture interfaces.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under ScreenCaptureKit — Deprecations with 120910350 in the first retained 144-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: Mac App Store offer-code redemption
changes.canonicalSummary: StoreKit added in-app redemption support for Mac App Store offer codes.
changes.summary: Mac applications can respond to supported offer-code redemptions without sending customers outside the app.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under StoreKit — New Features with 60096251 in the first retained 144-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: Original in-app purchase API deprecation
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple deprecated the original StoreKit in-app purchase API family and directed developers to newer StoreKit interfaces.
changes.summary: The archived state marks a broad set of older commerce types as deprecated rather than immediately removed.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under StoreKit — Deprecations with 116600524 in the first retained 144-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: Swift Charts function and vectorized plots
changes.canonicalSummary: Swift Charts added function plots and vectorized plotting APIs for mathematical and large-dataset visualizations.
changes.summary: LinePlot and AreaPlot cover functions, while PointPlot and RectanglePlot offer more efficient bulk rendering.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under Swift Charts — New Features with 117186178, 117469419 in the first retained 144-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: SwiftUI automatic sheet sizing
changes.canonicalSummary: SwiftUI sheets linked against the new SDK adopted automatic presentation sizing with platform-specific resolution.
changes.summary: Developers are asked to audit sheet layouts because the default differs from earlier macOS releases.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under SwiftUI — New Features with 117551515 in the first retained 144-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: System protection for app-group containers
changes.canonicalSummary: System Integrity Protection expanded to app-group containers and enforced entitlement and distribution requirements.
changes.summary: Properly entitled applications retain access, while unsupported access can be denied or require temporary user consent.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under System Integrity Protection — New Features with 114586798 in the first retained 144-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

citations.locator: System Integrity Protection — New Features; issue 114586798

changes.title: Translation API and Hindi support
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple added an in-app translation API and expanded system translation support to Hindi.
changes.summary: The initial state combines a developer-facing translation session interface with broader language coverage.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under Translation — New Features with 112844581, 116622913 in the first retained 144-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: Reduced App Store installation-space requirement
changes.canonicalSummary: The Mac App Store changed initial download requirements from roughly twice the app size to the final install size plus a buffer.
changes.summary: The documented storage calculation reduces the temporary free space needed to begin many app installations.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched by component, status heading, and issue ID as an addition across raw Apple DocC payloads 20240619212721 and 20240628225332; the interval crosses Beta 2 and no other local seed milestone.

changes.title: Application Firewall property-list settings removal
changes.canonicalSummary: Application Firewall settings stopped using the former property-list location, requiring supported command-line configuration.
changes.summary: Tools that edited the old preference file need to move to the documented socketfilterfw interface.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched by component, status heading, and issue ID as an addition across raw Apple DocC payloads 20240619212721 and 20240628225332; the interval crosses Beta 2 and no other local seed milestone.

changes.title: Intermittent MSDOS volume repair warning
changes.canonicalSummary: Beta 2 documented a startup warning that could incorrectly say a connected MSDOS volume needed repair or reformatting.
changes.summary: Apple cautioned against reformatting the volume in response to the intermittent message.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched by component, status heading, and issue ID as an addition across raw Apple DocC payloads 20240619212721 and 20240628225332; the interval crosses Beta 2 and no other local seed milestone.

changes.title: Universal Clipboard during iPhone Mirroring
changes.canonicalSummary: Beta 2 documented that Universal Clipboard might fail while iPhone Mirroring was active.
changes.summary: The limitation affects cross-device copy and paste during a mirrored session.

changes.title: Encrypted Time Machine network backups

changes.verificationMethod: Matched by component and issue ID as an explicit transition to Resolved Issues across raw Apple DocC payloads 20240619212721 and 20240628225332; the interval crosses Beta 2 and no other local seed milestone.

changes.title: iCloud Drive data use for frequently changed files

changes.title: iCloud Photo Library synchronization
changes.canonicalSummary: Beta 2 resolved a condition where photos and videos could stop synchronizing through iCloud Photo Library.
changes.summary: The Photos entry changes from a known synchronization failure to a documented resolution.

changes.title: Intel Mac battery and thermal load
changes.canonicalSummary: Beta 2 resolved elevated battery drain, temperature, and fan activity on certain Intel laptops with AMD graphics.

changes.verificationMethod: Matched by component and issue ID as an explicit transition to Resolved Issues across raw Apple DocC payloads 20240619212721 and 20240628225332; the interval crosses Beta 2 and no other local seed milestone.

changes.verificationMethod: Matched by component and issue ID as an explicit transition to Resolved Issues across raw Apple DocC payloads 20240619212721 and 20240628225332; the interval crosses Beta 2 and no other local seed milestone.

changes.title: SwiftUI NavigationView links
changes.canonicalSummary: Beta 2 resolved failures affecting some navigation links in the deprecated SwiftUI NavigationView.
changes.summary: The transition records the legacy navigation-link behavior as fixed.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched by component and issue ID as an explicit transition to Resolved Issues across raw Apple DocC payloads 20240619212721 and 20240628225332; the interval crosses Beta 2 and no other local seed milestone.

changes.title: iCloud sign-in inside macOS virtual machines
changes.canonicalSummary: Beta 2 restored iCloud account access and dependent services inside macOS virtual machines.
changes.summary: The virtual-machine account limitation moves from Known Issues to Resolved Issues.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched by component and issue ID as an explicit transition to Resolved Issues across raw Apple DocC payloads 20240619212721 and 20240628225332; the interval crosses Beta 2 and no other local seed milestone.

changes.title: VoiceOver completion of Setup Assistant
changes.canonicalSummary: Beta 2 resolved a VoiceOver problem that could block completion of some Setup Assistant stages.
changes.summary: The status transition documents improved accessibility during first-run setup.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched by component and issue ID as an explicit transition to Resolved Issues across raw Apple DocC payloads 20240619212721 and 20240628225332; the interval crosses Beta 2 and no other local seed milestone.
